title: The Honeyvale Pack
description: The official performance & enhancement modpack of the Honeyvale Minecraft server! (honeyvalemc.com)
body:
The official performance and Vanilla enhancement pack of the Honeyvale Minecraft server! ([http://honeyvalemc.com/](http://honeyvalemc.com/))

Come join us on Honeyvale! We're an inclusive community that strives to make everyone comfortable and happy. Our server is mainly geared towards PvE, building, and community.

Please be sure to follow our rules and have fun!

play.honeyvalemc.com
